predictions.rationale: Primary HTTP API that exposes and manages catalog items, brands, types, stock and related data used by storefront.
Entity representing product items including picture URI, price, stock and other item information.
EF Core DbContext holding CatalogItem, CatalogBrand and CatalogType sets and persisting stock data.
Database mapping configuration for CatalogItem including picture filename, price, and stock fields.
Dedicated controller handling product picture retrieval and management.
Seeds initial catalog items, brands, types and pictures for the storefront.
Utility extension methods related to catalog item picture URLs and data shaping.
gRPC service exposing catalog items and stock information to other services.
Frontend service querying catalog API to display items, pictures and stock in storefront.
Contains configuration for catalog picture storage locations and other item-related settings.
